topics.name: Routine Registry
topics.purpose: Define `#R` as the registry of inert authored Routine definitions and expose explicit run/cycle/status semantics without treating Routine storage or view access as execution.

semantics.definition_rule: Routine definition is inert authored data.
semantics.registry_rule: Each Routine has exact canonical identity.
semantics.content_rule: Routine contains explicit ordered/causal step semantics rather than relying on incidental JSON array order alone.
semantics.invocation_rule: Routine starts only through explicit `&` or canonical run operation.
semantics.status_rule: Active Routine execution status belongs to tracked runtime state.
semantics.cycle_rule: Cycle/loop behavior is explicit and bounded.
semantics.authority_rule: Reading/editing a Routine does not grant run authority.

invariants.rule: Automation semantics remain explicit across Event, Trigger, Runner and Routine identities, and execution order never derives from incidental structure or serialization order.

hard_gates.condition: routine identity inferred from file path
execution order derived only from incidental array order
